title: Welcome to TurboToad.net
content: My name is TurboToad12, I like photography and computers. I hope to use this site to showcase my projects and photo collections.

title: My opinion on the T4i.
excerpt: The T4i is a great beginner camera!
content:
I was gifted a Canon T4i for Christmas and I have taken many photos with it so far. 

The T4i is an older Dslr (2012) It has proved enough for my novice photography level. 

Most if not all of the photos on this site are from it, I recomend this as a great option for beginners.
